Title: First time setup does not require confirming password if "show password" box is checked
Body: First time setup does not require confirming password if "show password" box is checked

###### Info

* __Version__: 1.14
* __Source__: Google Play
* __Vault encrypted:__ Yes (with biometric unlock)
* __Device:__ Samsung Galaxy S10e, SM-G970U
* __Android version and ROM:__ Android 10, stock ROM

###### Steps to reproduce

1. Fresh install of app
2. Enable biometric unlock (fingerprint). Note: I did not test this without enabling biometric unlock
3. Type a password and click "show password"
4. Click enter or next without confirming password

###### What do you expect to happen?

A prompt for confirming the password would be expected here.

###### What happens instead?

No prompt, user is taken directly to the main page of the app

Title: Renaming error
Body: **Describe the bug**
Attempting to rename a category or a payee results in: "error: attempt to get lenght of null array"

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to "categories" or "payees"
2. Hold on a name
3. Click edit
4. Rename
5. Click ok

**Expected behavior**
The item gets renamed

**Device Information:**
 - Device: Xiaomi Mi 9t Pro
 - OS: Android 14 (Evolution X)
 - Storage: Phone storage
 - Encrypted: Yes
 - App Version: 2024.03.19

Title: Saving of end date is incorrect if end time is set afterwards
Body: **Description of the bug**
When setting a new contact, if an end time is set after setting an end date, the internals modify the end date previously set. Despite showing the correct end date, saving and opening the contact again show an incorrect end date. This does not happen when the order followed is Begin date - Begin time - End date.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create new contact or event
2. Set a begin date
3. Set an end date different from the begin date
4. Set a begin time
5. Save the entry and edit it. The end date is not the original one.

**Additional information**
When editing the contact/event, the problem does not appear. Therefore, it is only a problem in `NewContactActivity` and `NewEventActivity`.

Title: Latest version (2024.02.26) errors on editing 
Body: **Describe the bug**
I updated to the latest version but if I tried to edit a current transaction it errors and does not save.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to any current transaction and try to change the payee
2. Multiple errors when saving - cannot save. Have to revert.
3. Adding a new transaction is not affected 

**Expected behavior**
Should be able to edit old or recent transactions 

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Device Information:**
 - Device: [ Google pixel 7a]
 - OS: [e.g. Android 13]
 - Cloud Storage: [ Google drive]
 - App Version: [2024.02.26]

**Additional context**
Reverted back to version  2024.02.15 as this version does not have the issue.

Title: Restoring a backup hides the Menu
Body: ## Steps to Reproduce :
1. Open the app.
2. Click on Restore from backup
3. Continue
4. Select the backup
5. Notice the right side menu, search gets hidden

## Actual Behaviour 
Menu, search, backup menu inflated are hidden.

## Expected Behaviour: 
Menu, search, backup menu inflated should be shown after switching the backups.

## Video of reproduce

https://github.com/ankidroid/Anki-Android/assets/60827173/85a19938-9417-409b-9324-abe17cd9f8ca

Title: Tapping the Donate button does nothing
Body: **Describe the bug**
The 'Donate' button on the About screen  in 2024.12.22 (1054), 
2024.12.19 (1053) and earlier does nothing.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Tap the AMMEX menu.
2. Tap on 'About'.
3. Tap the 'Donate' button.
4. Nothing happens.

**Expected behavior**
I would expect that the Donate button would open a screen that allows you to make a donation to the AMMEX project.


**Device Information:**
 - Device: Samsung S22 Ultra
 - OS: Android 14
 - Storage: Phone storage + OneDrive
 - Synchronization: N/A
 - Encrypted: Yes with password
 - Security: Actived with passcode or fingerprint 
 - App Version: 2024.12.22 (1054)

**Additional context**
N/A

Title: [BUG] Copy text on an edited post copies the original text to clipboard 
Body: **Describe the bug**
Copy text on an edited post copies the original text to clipboard instead of the (new) edited text

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a new post
2. Edit the post and add new text
3. Copy text
4. Copied text is the original note text and not the new edited text

**Expected behavior**
Copied text should be the new edited content

**Device (please complete the following information):**
 - Phone Brand/Model Pixel 7 Pro
 - Android Version 34
 - App Version 89.7 google play

Title: Biometric or password during setup, broken? Results in wrong password everytime!
Body: ###### Info
I just downloaded the app from the android store, during the setup I choose biometric and set a password.
However, the problem is every time I try to unlock it says wrong password! For testing I choose **a1** as the password.
My fingerprint does not work either.
Same problem occurs if I only choose to encrypt with a password.
But if choose none from the start, and then once I'm in the app choose to protect it with a password, it works.

* __Version__: 1.2
* __Source__: Google Play
* __Vault encrypted:__ Yes
* __Device:__ OnePlus5
* __Android version and ROM:__ 10, Stock

###### Steps to reproduce

1. Clean install or clear the storage of the app.
2. Start the app.
3. In the setup choose Biometric and enter a password, I took **a1** for test
4. Once you enter the app close it.
5. Start the app again, and try to unlock it. Entering **a1** will result in wrong password!

###### What do you expect to happen?

The app to be unlocked with my password chosen during the setup.

###### What happens instead?

Wrong password instead.

###### Log

```
No log
```

Title: [BUG] Issue with changing language in Settings: a mix of languages
Body: **Describe the bug**
Changing language in settings results in mixed languages in the Settings page

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to Settings
2. Click on Language
3. Change it to another 100% translated language like Swedish
4. Go back to Settings
5. Change back language to English
6. Go back to Settings

**Expected behavior**
All settings text in english

**Actual Behaviour**
A mix of English and Swedish

**Device (please complete the following information):**
 - Phone Brand/Model Pixel 7 Pro]: 
 - Android Version 34 
 - App Version v0.90.6 Google Play

Title: [BUG] Non-english hashtags are not clickable and followable
Body: **Describe the bug**
Impossible to open non-english hashtags to follow them.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Post message with hashtag in english: `#test of hashtags`
2. Click and follow it
3. Post message with hashtag in russian (for example): `#тест хэштегов`
4. You can't click and follow this hashtag

**Expected behavior**
Clickable and followable non-english (probably non ASCII) hashtags.

**Screenshot**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46797839/231465916-3b72c1ef-4b4d-4941-926b-49cf5414a971.png)


**Device:**
 - Device: Google Pixel 6
 - Android 13
 - App Version [e.g. v0.20.3]: v0.29.2

**Bounty (in Bitcoin sats) offered for a solution**
35000 sats

Filter on downloaded episodes not updated after deletion
Checklist

I have used the search function to see if someone else has already submitted the same bug report.

I will describe the problem with as much detail as possible.

If the bug only to occurs with a certain podcast, I will include the URL of that podcast.
System info
App version: 2.0.1

App source: F-Droid

Android version: LineageOS 17.1 (Android 10)

Device model: OnePlus 6, Galaxy S4

Bug description
Steps to reproduce:

Download an episode of any podcast
Go to the list of episodes, filter on « Downloaded »
Notice the list is correctly filtered to the downloaded episode
Long press the episode and choose « Delete ».
Expected behaviour:
The deleted episode should be removed live from the list filtered on « Downloaded ».

Current behaviour:
The episode stays in the view although it’s not downloaded anymore.
It requires applying the filter again for the view to update.

First occurred: This is a regression of 2.0.1 vs. the 1.8.x series

Title: Suggstion check box inverted.
Body: Editor version 1.35.
Installed from F-Droid.
Device Xiaomi Mi8.
Android 9
Firmware: LineageOS 16.0-20190509-NIGHTLY-dipper

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open Editor.
2. Set settings check box for "Suggestion" marked.
3. Close Editor.
4. Open file from another application (X-Plore, OMN) by the Editor
5. Enter to edit mode by tapping pencil icon

At this state I expect suggestion above keyboard at typing time.
There is no suggestion.
If open settings suggestion check box marked. 
If tap this check box twice - suggestion appear.

But, if leave sugggestion settings disabled (check box not marked) and don't touch the settings next time input suggestion operate...

Another words explanation: suggestion settings stored in inverted state but if changed during edit session operate corresponding tick mark till session closed.

br_content:
Title: Widget: Notes List widget has unexpected behavior after logout
Body:
Expected
If I log out of the app after adding a Notes List Widget to my device home screen, I expect to see the prompt "Log in to use widget" and see the welcome screen when I tap the widget.

Observed
Right after I log out of the widget, I see the prompt "Log in to use widget" but when I tap it a new note is opened. After that, the widget is blank (no login prompt).

Also, if I resize the widget while logged out of the app, when the widget is large enough the new note button will appear.

Reproduced
Log in to the app.
Add the notes list widget to the device home screen.
Confirm the notes list widget works as expected (opening a note in the list or creating a new note).
Log out of the app.
Confirm the notes list widget shows the "Log in to use widget" message as expected.
Tap on the notes list widget and notice that it opens a new note in the note editor, instead of taking you to the login screen.


Make	Model	Android Version	App Version
Motorola	moto e5 play	8.1.0	2.5-rc-1

Title: Block Cookies Option is not following Language Selection 
Body:
Steps to reproduce
Open the settings menu.

Go to privacy and security.

Scroll down to the Cookies and Site Data/Block Cookies and observe the selection.

Return to the settings menu.

Click on the language and select a language other than current language.

Repeat the 2nd and 3rd steps, and observe the Block Cookies.

Expected behavior
The option chosen in Block Cookies is shown in Current Language selected by User. 

Actual behavior
The Option chosen by the user is not showing in the language selected rather in Previous Language selected by user.

br_content:
Title: Editor - Publish confirmation dialog shown on Save action
Body:
Expected behavior
When I edit a local draft (a draft created while offline) and I click on SAVE action the draft is uploaded to the server.

Actual behavior
When I edit a local draft (a draft created while offline) and I click on SAVE action a "Ready to publish? Keep editing / Publish now" dialog is shown. If I click on "publish now" action on the dialog the post gets actually published.

Steps to reproduce the behavior
turn airplane mode ON
start a draft, give it a title, some content
exit the editor and observe it's saved as Local Drafts
open it again
edit the title or content
tap on SAVE (navigation bar)
observe the "Ready to publish? Keep editing / Publish immediately" dialog is shown
Tested on [device], Android [version], WPAndroid [version]
Emulator Android 9

Change [Language] from English to Japanese.

[Card info], one of the items of the menu, has been translated into Japanese.

https://crowdin.com/translate/ankidroid/all/en-ja?filter=basic&value=0#q=Card%20info

The strings, "Card info", hasn't been translated.

Tap "x" on the file to remove from hidden files list.
Tap "Cancel".

Title: Renaming tag to existing tag on the same note results in wrong notes count and duplicate tags on note 
Body:
Expected
When I rename a tag to an existing tag, I expect the tag to be de-duped everywhere. (No duplicate tags or notes count.)

Observed
When I rename a tag to an existing tag, it is de-duped correctly in the tags list (a duplicate tag isn't created). However, if both tags were used on the same note, the notes count for the tag is erroneously increased by 1 and that tag appears twice on that note.

Reproduced
Create a new note.
Add two tags to the note (e.g. tag1 and tag2).
Open the navigation drawer.
Tap "Edit" next to "Tags."
Tap one of the tags you just added (e.g. tag2).
Rename that tag to the other tag on the note (e.g. rename tag2 to tag1).
Notice that a duplicate tag is not created, but the notes count for the other tag (e.g. tag1) increases by 1 even though that note was already included in the count.
Open the note again and notice it now has two identical tags (e.g. tag1 and tag1).

Device Make: Motorola
Device Model: moto e5 play
Android Version: 8.1.0
Simplenote Version: 2.9-rc-1

Bug Report: Preview Returns to Wrong Card After Editing

App: AnkiDroid

Component: Card Browser → Preview → Edit Note

Steps to Reproduce:

Open Card Browser (e.g. showing deck A)

Switch to another deck (e.g. B)

Select multiple cards (e.g. cards 1, 2, 3)

Open "Preview" from the options menu

Tap "Edit note" on one card, make a change, then tap "Save"

Expected:
Return to the preview of the edited card (from deck B)

Actual:
Returned to a different card from a different deck (e.g. back to deck A)

br_content:
Title: Adding new cards while reviewing does not update counters
Body: 
Some times cause negative count of remaining cards to review.
Reproduction Steps
Open a deck that is below the new card limit
While reviewing, add a new card
Keep reviewing
Expected Result
The new card counter (blue) should be increased as soon as the new card is added.

Actual Result
The new card counter is not increased and will eventually become negative.

Debug info
AnkiDroid Version = 2.12.1

Android Version = 10

ACRA UUID = 89032829-485f-4afd-a966-61ad635fd68c

Title: [Bug] In languages other than English, the latter half of the gesture-triggered action menu causes malfunction
Body:
Reproduction Steps
In Settings - AnkiDroid - Language, select a language other than English, e.g. German, French, Japanese, Chinese simplified.
Then, in the language,

Select Settings - Gestures - Enable gestures.

Tap Swipe up.

Tap Bury note in the menu.

Strictly speaking, to make sure, tap the item whose string should correspond to Bury note.

e.g.
Tap Notiz aufschieben
Tap Enterre la note
Tap ノートを延期
Tap 隐藏笔记

'action': 'swipe', 'feature':  'up' 

Expected Result
The next card is displayed.

Then, if you select English in Language, and re-open the Swipe up action menu, you see Bury note selected, of course.

Actual Result
The learning is aborted, and the home screen (the Decks screen) is displayed.

Then, if you select English in Language, and re-open the Swipe up action menu, you see Abort learning selected.

Debug info
Ver.2.14.0

The upper 10 items in the menu (the items above the blue line in the following image) work properly.

In languages other than English and Japanese, the string which should correspond to Card info doesn't exist.

(In Japanese, it didn't either, but I added it on November 8. The Japanese string which should correspond to Lookup expression has gone missing instead.)

Instead of the string which should correspond to Card info, the string which should do to Tag note actually correspond to Card info. In other words, the translated string for Tag note has slid up to the position of Card info.

This "sliding up by one step" continues until the item whose string should correspond to Page Down, i.e. until the third item from the bottom (the item on the green line in the image).

The second item from the bottom, whose string also correspond to Page Down, works properly, or the item hasn't been translated (e.g. in German).

This discordance has originally occurred on Crowdin for some reason.

Title: webm 360p not showing up
Body:
Checklist

I am using the latest version - 0.20.8

I checked, but didn't find any duplicates (open OR closed) of this issue in the repo.

I have read the contribution guidelines given at https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md.

This issue contains only one bug. I will open one issue for every bug report I want to file.
Steps to reproduce the bug
1.Go to setting and choose default audio and video format as webm
2.Watch any video which is in webm format
3. see that every format except 360p is in webm format same goes for download

Actual behaviour
360p should be available in webm format like all other resolutions

Expected behavior
360p isn't in webm format

Screenshots/Screen recordings
bug1
bug2

Logs
Device info
Android version/Custom ROM version: android 7 based on miui 11.2
Device model: mido

Body:
Regression Test
Please use *Yr1::Med2::CAS4::F4: Renal::BRS (zanki)::HY as input. Works in Anki Desktop

Reproduction Steps
Name a deck *Hello (zanki)
Add a card
Card Browser
Note: Hello (zanki) and *Hello both work fine

Expected Result
Card is shown
Actual Result
Card is not shown
Debug info
Latest alpha

body: **Describe the bug**
When clicking on a link in the "Important Links" section, the link opens but is copied twice.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Open the app and go to the "Important Links" section.
2. Click on any link.
3. The link opens, but it is copied twice.

**Expected behavior**
Clicking on the link should only open the link in a browser or another relevant app without copying it.

**Screenshots**
![bug](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f093309d-1093-4ed1-a285-6d1ee3b3eb69)

**Smartphone (please complete the following information):**
 - Device: [Vivo z5x]
 - OS: [OriginOS1.0]

**Additional context**
It seems that the link is being copied twice after it is opened. The issue could be related to the app's link handling mechanism, which needs adjustment to prevent duplication.

title: [bug] multiple tag deletion doesn't work
body: Steps to recreate:
1. Go to tags section in the side menu
2. Add at least 2 tags
3. Hold one of them
4. Tap on "select more"
5. Select at least 2 tags
6. Tap the 3 dots above
7. Tap the "delete"
8. Observe menu closing and deletion not happening.

Quillpad installed from F-Droid.

Also gonna take this occasion to notify that I added Quillpad to my TagsResearch collection and ask a question.

Were the tags your own feature as a fork of Quillnote?

I was using Quillnote for few years and never noticed that option then. But I also only used it for strictly pure text notes so I didn't use a lot of the options there - just a Google Keep alternative for notes.

Here's Quillpad entry in TagsResearch if anybody's interested:
https://github.com/Qronikarz/TagsResearch/blob/main/components/quillpad.md
